title: Unctuous Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring lamb, pickle juice, and bhuna spices, perfect for a midnight craving. This nut-free-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the bhuna spice mix, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the pickle juice, chicken broth, and honey, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the tagine or Dutch oven, and simmer the mixture for 2 1/2 hours, until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped dried apricots and continue to simmer the mixture for an additional 30 minutes, until the apricots are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
